championGate: THE ONE HARD SEQUENCE RULE, and it is canon's own: #100's gauntlet opens on the region's FULL Fragment count — every Fragment, whatever order earned. Counting, not ordering: the case (#213) fills in any order and the gate reads the fill. Elite Four + Champion beyond keep #100's own order — the capstone is a spine and does not bend
lossRule: a failed attempt writes an attempt record (read by #173's rematch machinery) and nothing else: no Fragment, no lock-out, no scaling mercy on the rematch. Readiness is the player's strategy
note: Reconciliation, not override: #143's Region 1 linearity is read as authored DATA standing unchanged; the open-order system lands around it. Registered in STAGING for the link-check.

threeVerbs.attempt: any dojo the Ranger can REACH (#297/#127) may be attempted in any order reaching allows. A dojo never scales down (#52/#139 law): the eighth dojo met in week one is the eighth dojo. Order is strategy, not permission
threeVerbs.earn: a Fragment is earned by the dojo's own test under its own rules (#45 + #133 as they apply per dojo); earning writes the one progress fact the league counts (#98 case, #213 presentation)
threeVerbs.spine: a region's story beats keep their own prerequisites in their own records (#139 story-locked class). A story-gated dojo declares a #297-class gate with an in-world reason in its record — never a silent level wall
